episodes.synopsis: In the near future, a unique metal known as "phantometal" is used to usher in a new trend into the hip-hop scene. Illusions are manufactured through emotions, making a magnificent display for the "Phantom Lives" sweeping across the world.
episodes.title: CLUB Paradox

episodes.synopsis: cozmez, a team of twins named Kanata and Nayuta Yatonokami grew up in less-than-ideal circumstances. Living in the slums of society, the brothers make a living to support one another.
episodes.title: DESIRE

episodes.synopsis: Ryu Natsume is a unique member of The Cat’s Whiskers. He doesn’t experience trap reactions when using phantometal and his past is wrapped in mystery. One day, Ryu finds a kitten and brings it home.
episodes.title: JUSTICE

episodes.synopsis: BAE pay a visit to The Cat’s Whiskers dressing room before the battle. Disregarding Allen and Anne’s respect for them, Hajun makes a harsh evaluation, but Ryu’s brief comment sets Hajun into a rage as he leaves the room.
episodes.title: PRIDE

episodes.synopsis: Akanyatsura are a family full of chivalry. Each of them burdened by the trauma of a certain event, they think of each other as a family unrelated by blood.
episodes.title: FAMILY

episodes.synopsis: The first single from when BURAIKAN were independent appears, which catches the attention of many. Elsewhere, Iori and Kanata discuss the dangerous truth about Phantometal.
episodes.title: SECRET

episodes.synopsis: Shiki is forced to confront his inner demons to remember what happened "that night" with Nayuta.
episodes.title: LOVE

episodes.synopsis: In the run-up to BAE's challenge against Akanyatsura, Hajun suffers the consequences of his exposure to the Phantometal. His BAE teammates must enter his mind to save him.
episodes.title: VIBES

episodes.synopsis: After saving Hajun, BAE decide to go to a traditional Japanese inn with hot springs in search of tranquility. However, a legend that speaks of the good fortune attracted by a rainbow beetle that inhabits the area will transform this break into a meeting of rappers in search of the beetle.
episodes.title: BREAK

episodes.synopsis: Allen's past haunts him to the point that a reunion with his father causes him to flee from BAE's battle against cozmez.
episodes.title: LOST

episodes.synopsis: The extra battle is coming up, but without BAE, Cozmez automatically wins. But another shock awaits Kanata...
episodes.title: MEMORIES

episodes.synopsis: Kanata has fallen into the clutches of an unscrupulous researcher. Can the others still save him?
episodes.title: Paradox Live
